# pvecli node updates

Pending package updates per node (read only unless --refresh).

The list comes from the last apt refresh of each node; --refresh runs
one first (apt update, nothing is installed).

```text
pvecli node updates [NODE] [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `NODE` | Node (default: every online node). |

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `--refresh` | Run apt update on the nodes first. |
| `--packages` | List the packages, not only their count. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile(s): name, list, pattern ('client-*') or @group. |
| `--json` | Output raw JSON to stdout (no colors, no tables). |
